descriptions.w3d_rb_increment_80351ef8: STLport _Rb_global<bool>::_M_increment: returns the in-order successor of a red-black tree node.
descriptions.w3d_rb_rebalance_for_erase_80352010: STLport _Rb_global<bool>::_Rebalance_for_erase: unlinks a node from the tree, fixes root/leftmost/rightmost and restores the red-black invariants; returns the node to free.
